title: Chapter 4: ROS 2 Integration with Isaac Sim
description: The Robot Operating System (ROS 2) is a flexible framework for writing robot software, providing tools, libraries, and conventions for building complex robot applications. Integrating ROS 2 with NVIDIA Isaac Sim combines the strengths of both platforms: Isaac Sim's high-fidelity simulation and synthetic data generation capabilities with ROS 2's powerful ecosystem for robot control, communication, and navigation.
